summary: Fortuna Mining filed a 6-K carrying a news release dated November 2, 2026, reporting first drill results from the Kabewest prospect at its recently acquired Bambadji Project in Senegal, adjacent to the Diamba Sud Gold Project. Highlights include 1.9 g/t Au over an estimated true width of 64 meters from 19 meters in hole FBRC0008, with mineralization intersected over 600 meters of strike and open along strike and depth. The 45-hole, 10,524-meter initial program is complete, part of an $8 million, 51,000-meter campaign; an initial Inferred Mineral Resource estimate is planned for Q1 2027. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated; this is routine exploration disclosure, not a special situation.
